name: BearBirdPad

inputs.description: Your own Banjo-Kazooie (USA) ROM (absolute path), read while preparing generated code.

tools.name: %ProgramFiles(x86)%/Microsoft Visual Studio/Installer/vswhere.exe
tools.label: Visual Studio C++ Build Tools
tools.note: Install Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools with Desktop development with C++ and a Windows SDK. x64 Windows needs x64/x86 C++ tools; Windows ARM64 can use ARM64 tools (preferred) or x64/x86 tools.

publication.reason: Private modules and personal apps contain code translated from the player-owned ROM. Public binary publication remains paused under the repository audit policy.

notes: Draft next-release module route. Requires PadMint portable SDK and managed MIPS compiler updates, plus a matching empty shell supplied with --app until an audited shell release exists. Existing manual Mac static build scripts remain supported. See docs/WINDOWS_MODULE.md for evidence and gates.
